cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Recruit Them Twice
cards.instruction: Recruit them to your side, then reveal that the side, goal, or conflict is not what it first appeared to be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you help me tidy the committee cupboard? Keep dated papers separate from loose notes, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. These are all last year's minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the missed votes. We'll need those dates when we ask for a new committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I agreed to filing, not getting people voted out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fair distinction. Leave the filing there. Will you check the missed-vote dates with me and co-sign a request for an election?

reason: Remove the final sentence explaining separate consent; the explicit second recruitment already performs it.
